from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyCompletion(BaseModel):
    """A record of housing completions for a single month from a specific report."""
    month: str = Field(description="The specific month of the data in YYYY-MM format")
    total_completions: float = Field(description="Not seasonally adjusted total housing completions")
    single_family_completions: float = Field(description="Not seasonally adjusted single-family completions")
    report_release_date: str = Field(description="The release date of the document this data came from, used to resolve conflicts")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    records: list[MonthlyCompletion]
